Hello, and welcome to Safe Online! My name is Ryan, and this is my channel about cybersecurity. I make short tutorials for beginners. I really enjoy teaching, and I love helping people. Many people do not like reading long manuals. They prefer watching a short video. So every Monday, I upload a new episode. This week, the playlist is about passwords. In episode one, you learn how to create a strong password. If you enjoy this video, please subscribe to the channel. See you next Monday!

Hi Estephano, it is Sara from the Game Club. You asked me to recommend a good series, so here it is: Mr. Robot. It is about a young man who works in cybersecurity. I am streaming it now, and I really enjoy watching it. There are four seasons, and each episode is about fifty minutes. I prefer watching it with English subtitles, because the characters speak fast. You love technology, so I think you will like it. Tell me what you think on Friday. Bye!
